P01.rationale: The page features two large, prominent portraits of men in a studio setting that serve as the dominant visual anchors.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies or client portraits present on this page; it is a single testimonial layout.

P07.rationale: The two men in the image function as a social-proof apparatus by visually representing real clients/testimonials rather than using generic stock photos.

P10.rationale: There are no oversized decorative typographic elements or ghost numerals; the typography is standard editorial text.

P11.rationale: The page contains no data visualisations, charts, or cost-math graphics.

P12.rationale: The layout reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial spread that fills the frame with photography and text.

P13.rationale: A specific studio atmosphere is created using dark curtains, professional lighting fixtures, and a branded backdrop.

P14.rationale: The overlaid text sits directly on the busy photo without any scrim or darkening treatment, making it difficult to read.

P16.rationale: A professional camera rig is clearly visible in the foreground, adding real product credibility and context to the scene.

N07.rationale: The imagery looks specific to a real business (recruiting agency) rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse dead whitespace; the composition is tightly packed with visual elements and text.

N10.rationale: Text sits directly on a busy photo without a scrim or inset gap, creating poor readability and awkward placement.
